title: Pure Libromancer
summary: Libromancer cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Libromancer is a Ritual strategy whose Main Deck monsters Special Summon themselves from the hand by revealing a Ritual Monster, gaining powerful bonus effects when Ritual Summoned using monsters on the field as material.

summary.title: Starters
points: Libromancer Geek Boy: Reveals a Ritual Monster in hand to Special Summon itself, then searches a Libromancer Spell such as First Appearance or Origin Story.
Libromancer Fire: Reveals a Ritual Monster to summon itself, then searches any Libromancer monster to find your missing Ritual Monster or extender.
Libromancer First Appearance: Field Spell that adds a Libromancer monster on activation and Ritual Summons once per turn by tributing monsters from hand or field.
Libromancer Origin Story: Sets a Libromancer Spell or Trap directly from the Deck on activation, and destroys an opponent's Spell or Trap card each time you Ritual Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Geek Boy and Fire
steps: Special Summon Libromancer Geek Boy from hand by revealing any Libromancer Ritual Monster, triggering its effect to search Libromancer First Appearance.
Activate Libromancer First Appearance to add Libromancer Fire from Deck to hand.
Special Summon Libromancer Fire by revealing the Ritual Monster, searching Libromancer Doombroker or Libromancer Agent.
Activate First Appearance to Ritual Summon Libromancer Doombroker using Geek Boy and Fire on the field, granting Doombroker its bonus field-material protection.
Trigger Doombroker to Set Libromancer Intervention directly from the Deck for interruption.

summary.title: Bosses & Ritual Payoffs
points: Libromancer Doombroker: Can attack directly, Sets a Libromancer Trap from your Deck, and shuffles an opponent's monster into the Deck when it inflicts battle damage if summoned using field material.
Libromancer Fireburst: Double battle damage dealer that can attack twice on monsters and cannot be destroyed by battle when summoned using field material.
Libromancer Mystigirl: Zeroes an opponent's monster's ATK and negates its activated effects on summon, shielding your Ritual Monsters from targeting.
Libromancer Firestarter: Grows stronger with every opponent activation and cannot be destroyed or banished by card effects when made with field materials.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Libromancer Intervention: Returns a Libromancer Ritual Monster from field to hand to negate an opponent's card or effect activation and place it on the bottom of the Deck.
Libromancer Bonded: Archetypal Ritual Spell that Ritual Summons a Libromancer by tributing monsters from hand or field, providing targeting immunity to Fireburst.
Libromancer Displaced: Quick-Play Spell that targets and returns a Libromancer monster to hand to take control of an opponent's monster until the End Phase.
Libromancer Realized: Continuous Spell that creates a Libromancer Token matching the Level of a revealed Ritual Monster for tribute fodder.
